text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "The DiffTRe diamond potential (a DimeNet++ model) was trained on experimental elastic stiffness tensor data for diamond. The loss used three distinct stiffness moduli, C11 = 1079 GPa, C12 = 124 GPa and C44 = 578 GPa (Voigt notation), together with the assumption of a stress-free state at zero strain [W3168247670#013]. The simulation temperature (298.15 K) and density (3512 kg/m3) were also taken from experimental values [W3168247670#013]."}
